headline: THE LAUNCH
chyron: TECH GIANT LAUNCHES PHONE WITH NO PHONE IN IT
ticker: NEW PHONE: NO SCREEN, NO BUTTONS, NO PHONE
PRE-ORDERS SOLD OUT IN FOUR MINUTES
CAREERCRASH.ORG: THE INFLUENCER WAS NOT INVITED EITHER

beats.text: Tonight: a tech giant has launched a phone with no screen, no buttons and no phone. Bev Fizzwilliam is at the launch.
Darlings. I'm on the rooftop, the canapés are tiny, and the phone is... conceptual.
The CEO let me hold it. Lovely weight. No idea where to put my hands.
Bev! Brock here! What does it DO?
Nothing, darling. It respects your boundaries. Unlike the after-party, which I'm told has a {bleep}.
Bev, are you drinking on air?
Only the prosecco, darling. And a little of the other prosecco.
Philippa, you look stunning tonight. Very stern. Very... {bleep}.
Thank you, Bev. You also look. Present.
Back to you, Brock. Back to you. Front to you also, if you're free.
Philippa, she likes ME! And you're BLUSHING!

realStory.text: Made up. Phones keep losing ports and buttons; this one has finally lost the phone. Bev went home at a reasonable hour (2 a.m.).

signoff: Bev sends her love, and a canapé, to everyone. Especially Philippa.
